selection_basis: Chosen from pre-existing geographically diverse acquisition queue using pixel review/component annotatability only; no model output was run on these records before this freeze.
evaluation_rule: No final-holdout model inference until the development method and operating point are explicitly frozen. Final-holdout results must not be used for further tuning if presented as headline evidence.
claim_boundary: Assistant visual labels remain provisional portfolio reference unless independently human-adjudicated; no material/condition/corrosion/defect/safety-risk claim is encoded.
